test_ndarray_zeros: test ndarray_ext.zeros to create zero-filled N-dimensional arrays with various shapes and dtypes
test_ndarray_zeros_matrix: test ndarray_ext.zeros_matrix to create zero-filled numpy matrix objects with a given shape and dtype
test_ndarray_array: test ndarray_ext.array to construct numpy arrays from Python sequences with optional dtype
test_ndarray_empty: test ndarray_ext.empty and c_empty to allocate uninitialized N-dimensional arrays with specified shape and dtype
test_ndarray_transpose: test ndarray_ext.transpose to transpose a numpy array and verify the resulting shape matches numpy
